_comment: Cloudflare R2 bucket CORS policy for the helm-files bucket. Apply with `pnpm --filter @helm/api apply:r2-cors` (see apps/api/scripts/README.md). Web origins listed below must include every origin that PUTs (uploads) or GETs (downloads) a presigned URL. R2 supports wildcards in the subdomain segment of an origin.

CORSRules._comment: Direct-PUT uploads from the web app to R2 + presigned-GET downloads. The browser sends `Content-Type` and may attach `Content-MD5` / `Content-Length`; the AWS SDK signed URL also accepts the `x-amz-*` family. ETag is exposed so the client can verify the upload.
